title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: Hold: the table says no automation is documented for reviewing connected agents, but Microsoft Graph documents retrieval of the agent's complete manifest, where these connections are declared. The installation and blocking paths and calls are supported; some role citations have moved, and Microsoft pages disagree about connection limits and editing.

claims.claim: Microsoft is introducing Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes using Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

claims.claim: The roadmap says agents published to Agent 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: The roadmap description names Agent Builder and Copilot Studio as builders of agents using these connections.
claims.quote: If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.
